facts.business: Sodhani Capital Limited is an AMFI-registered mutual fund distributor serving retail and HNI clients with mutual fund products and basic investment advice.
key_risks: Regulatory Risk: Adverse changes in SEBI/AMFI regulations may impact revenue and operations
Market Risk: Revenue linked to AUM; adverse market conditions may lead to lower inflows, higher redemptions, and decline in commission income
Operational & Technology Risk: Dependency on digital platforms and RTA systems exposes the company to technical glitches, cyber security threats, and data privacy breaches
Competition Risk: Intense competition from banks, national distributors, fintech platforms, and direct plans; increasing investor preference for direct plans may impact commission income
Reputational Risk: Mis-selling, non-compliance with AMFI Code of Conduct, or investor grievances may lead to regulatory action, ARN cancellation, and reputational damage
